phase_prompt.summary: Initial discovery of the chamber with its glowing glyphs and obsidian altar.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic view of a subterranean temple chamber with vaulted basalt walls etched in luminous hieroglyphs, a massive obsidian altar at the center surrounded by pulsing crystalline conduits, bronze filigree panels dusted with ancient soot, bio-luminescent moss along the stone, flickering torchlight casting deep shadows, and a faint humming of incomprehensible technology.
